🔬 We taught an AI to stop guessing and start wondering.

New episode traces the 5-paper journey to building the first autonomous AI scientist — tested in 22 simulated alien universes designed specifically to catch it cheating off memorized textbooks.
One failure mode: models dismissed contradictory data as "noise" rather than admit their Earth-physics assumptions were wrong.
